scenes.text: Gemini Notebook now *records your meetings* and *answers questions* about them

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: Oct 27: the Notebook mobile app got a built-in recorder. Tap, record up to an hour, and the audio becomes a source you can question.
Pair it with photos of handwritten notes in the same notebook.

scenes.title: The *money* use
lines: Freelancers: record the discovery call, with permission. Then ask: 'List what the client wants, budget hints and three open questions.'
Draft the proposal from that. Bill the hour, not the typing.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: One hour per recording, so split long meetings.
Recording laws vary; ask before you press record. Source: Google on X, Oct 27; Digital Trends, Oct 28, 2026.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: Free with a Google account. Google AI Pro ($19.99 a month) raises the limits.
No separate transcription app to pay for.

scenes.text: Tag a freelancer who still *types notes* on calls.
